topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I opened the attic door, the creak echoing through the dimly lit space, and stepped carefully onto the aged floorboards. Each step seemed to hold the weight of forgotten years. Dust moticled the stale air, swirling around me like whispers of a past I didn’t know. I found them tucked away, wrapped in tattered sheets and old newspapers—CLOCKS, so many clocks, each tick echoing the silence of the room. They stared back with hands frozen at odd hours, as if they had all stopped at different moments, refusing to agree on the time. I couldn’t help but wonder, who left them here, and why? The walls seemed to lean in, as if eager to share their secrets, but I closed the door, feeling the weight of those silent, accusing hands.
